concerns.text: Phase 5 mentions that pruning runs every 10 tasks, but it does not explicitly state that the pruning heuristic follows the FR‑004 definition (remove a skill only when `usage_count == 0` **and** `min_cosine_similarity_to_any_other_skill_in_library < 0.70`). Adding this explicit alignment ensures the plan fully satisfies the functional requirement and avoids ambiguity.
